home-desk.alt: The nurses' desk at night. You sit under a lamp reading a message on a screen; Bea leans on the desk with a mug of tea; Wick, the little clockwork owl, sits on the corner of the desk in the lamplight.

ch00-tube.alt: A tall brass speaking tube rises from a sleek dark cabinet on the corner of the nurses' desk, glowing faintly teal. You and Bea regard it warily; Bea holds a printed letter.

ch00-cupboard.alt: In the supply cupboard, by torchlight, you find the little clockwork owl on a high shelf among boxes of gauze, a paper tag tied to its foot.

ch01-opener.alt: Late at night under the desk lamp, Wick the clockwork owl sits on the desk with a small brass paper-tape reader fitted into its chest. You feed a strip of punched paper tape into it; Bea watches over her mug, an index card pinned on the noticeboard behind her.

ch01-felttip.alt: Wick sits alone on the desk with a curl of printed tape spilling from its chest, beside a child's felt-tip pen with its cap off and a few purple scribbles on a scrap of paper.

ch02-opener.alt: You fit a little brass card drawer into Wick's side, full of index cards, while Bea leans on the desk with her tea. Paper tape from the night before curls off the desk.

ch02-three.alt: Three in the morning. The desk is covered in index cards, crossed out and pinned together, the card drawer in Wick's side overflowing; you sit back, exhausted, pen in hand.

ch03-opener.alt: Under the desk lamp, you fit a row of small brass knobs across Wick's chest with a jeweller's screwdriver while Bea looks on, mug in hand.

ch03-training.alt: Wick sits alone on the desk while the knobs on its chest turn by themselves, a long strip of paper tape pouring out.

ch04-opener.alt: Under the desk lamp, Wick's chest panel hangs open on a hinge, showing a tangle of fine copper wires behind the row of brass knobs. You lean in with a soldering iron, a thin curl of smoke rising; Bea watches over your shoulder, mug in hand.

ch04-ink.alt: Wick sits among a drift of paper message slips. At the foot of many of the slips is the same small stamp in purple ink, and Wick's eyes are fixed on the stamps, not on the writing.

ch11-opener.alt: Under the desk lamp you lean in to read a small brass gauge newly fitted on Wick's chest, its needle caught mid-waver, while Bea points up at the clock on the wall.

ch11-slips.alt: At four in the morning a corkboard behind the desk is filling with dozens of small paper slips from Wick, more arriving, while you rub your eyes.
